summary: Join our Cloud Native Application Development Training Course to master the skills needed for developing scalable, efficient applications in the cloud.
lede: Cloud-native application development covers designing, packaging, deploying, and operating distributed applications built from microservices. It is for developers, DevOps and platform engineers, software architects, and site reliability engineers who need to move applications from local development into cluster-based environments. Learners practice building container images, deploying workloads with Kubernetes, automating delivery with CI and GitOps, and monitoring services with observability tools.
audienceIntro: This training is engineered for technical professionals responsible for designing, building, deploying, and maintaining modern distributed applications in cloud environments.
modules: Service Mesh and Cloud Native Security
prerequisites: Participants should have a working knowledge of at least one programming language (e.g., Python, Go, Java, or Node.js), basic Linux terminal commands, and fundamental cloud computing concepts. No prior Kubernetes or container orchestration experience is required, though familiarity with basic software development lifecycles will be highly beneficial.
